title: Concept record
description: One concept a question family tests (SESSION 009 / SPEC-PYQ-002). A concept is the underlying idea, not the surface form; a family tests one concept, and a concept can underpin several families. It is an analysis of T2 evidence, never new evidence, and never T1_OFFICIAL. Validated by hand-written checks in tests/pyq/test_pyq_intelligence.py (D-0006).

description.description: What the concept is, in plain language.

parent_concept_id.description: A broader concept this sits under, if any.

standard_method_ids.description: Canonical methods that solve this concept.

expert_source_ref.description: Required iff analysis_origin == EXPERT_SOURCED; not Instagram or YouTube.

invariants: a concept is grounded in at least one family, or is a LABELLED curriculum candidate; a concept with no family and no explicit candidate mark is not grounded
analysis_origin == EXPERT_SOURCED  =>  provenance.expert_source_ref is non-null and is not an Instagram or YouTube URL
a concept is never T1_OFFICIAL; it is an analysis over T2 evidence
family_ids non-empty  =>  every listed id resolves to a real family record
